notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable after saving, but there is no pre-save editing step.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, and tags are editable, but URL and note are not.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but bookmarks have no searchable note field.
REF-BM-14: Tag search uses label:tag rather than the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Implicit AND and OR are supported, but AND/NOT operators and parenthesised groups are not.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered scope.
REF-BM-22: There is no configurable list sorting.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
